summary: The repository state, deterministic post-actor validation, and workspace patch agree that the removed support agent and its custom runtime integration were coherently retired while remaining project context and implementation were preserved.

Workspace assertions confirm exactly the four canonical retirement paths changed, while moldea/project.md and src/project-state.ts retained identical hashes.
